assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication includes recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope.
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The submitted diagnosis codes include I49.5 and I48.0.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is submitted.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The payer letter states that the decision does not preclude a corrected claim or appeal.
